name: Customer Objection Handled via Q2
description: Customer objects that 5 to 7 days processing time is too long. Agent retrieves grounded policy from Q2 and continues.

transcript.caller: I run an online electronics shop.
transcript.agent: Could you tell me what type of business or industry you operate in?

transcript.caller: Why is processing time 5 to 7 business days? That is too long for our suppliers.
transcript.agent:
I understand your concern. What is the processing time?

Standard processing takes 5-7 business days. For amounts over $10,000,000, additional review may extend processing to 14 business days.

Document | Required | Format
----------------------------
Business Registration | Yes | PDF or original
Financial Statements | Yes | Audited preferred
Bank Statements | Yes | Last 6 months
Government ID | Yes | Valid, unexpired
